thread:
maya: quick flag 1: SDKs returning inconsistent error shapes leaking into apps. I sketched a migration plan, would love quick feedback.

oliver: send it here. we need something minimal that apps can rely on without huge migrations.

maya: gist: canonical server error shape: {
  "error_code": "namespace.short_code",
  "error_class": "AUTH|RATE_LIMIT|SERVER|CLIENT",
  "user_message": "friendly text",
  "retry_after": number|null,
  "meta": {} // optional opaque metadata for internal use only
}

sophia: love the separation user_message vs code. SDKs should expose typed exceptions named after error_code parts, e.g., AuthTokenExpiredError. Also include numeric enum mapping for telemetry.

rachel: proposal for compatibility: 1) server emits both new shape and legacy `message` for 90 days, 2) SDKs map both shapes to same typed exception, 3) deprecate `message` in server logs after warning period.

tom: infra note: adding the dual-shape will need contract-checker updates. I can add a lint rule that fails if `error_code` missing.

oliver: example JS SDK surface:
```js
try { await client.generate(...) } catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof RateLimitError) { await sleep(err.retryAfter || backoff()) }
  else if (err instanceof AuthTokenExpiredError) { await refreshAndRetry() }
  else throw err
}
```
Ensure `.retryAfter` exists when server set it.

maya: Python example for mapping to typed exceptions:
```py
class APIError(Exception): pass
class RateLimitError(APIError):
    def __init__(self, user_message, retry_after=None, error_code=None):
        super().__init__(user_message)
        self.retry_after = retry_after
        self.error_code = error_code
```
SDK should raise these instead of generic HTTPError.

sophia: also add a small sample app showing best-practice: catch typed errors once in a helper and centralize retry/backoff. that makes onboarding easier.

rachel: timeline suggestion: RFC + server contract PR in 1 week, SDK patches next week, sample app + console mapping in 2 weeks. conservative rollback plan included.

ci-bot: contract-checker: found 3 endpoints still returning plain `message` only (v1/embeddings, v1/chat/stream). See CI #4973.

maya: thanks CI. Tom, can you triage the failing endpoints?

tom: on it. adding tickets to the RFC.

oliver: telemetry mapping note: map error_class -> metric labels and error_code -> dimension for alerting. sample: error_class=RATE_LIMIT, error_code=rate_limit.exceeded.

sophia: on SDK checklist: add migration examples, changelog entries, deprecation warnings, and quick samples for retry policies. I'll produce a PR template.

maya: decision points for RFC: names for classes, exact field names (use `user_message` not `message`), compatibility window (90 days?), and whether to include `meta` free-form.

rachel: +1 to 90 days. include example curl responses and a small `curl -> SDK` mapping section so support can help customers.

maya: ok sending rough RFC in ~2h. tagging eng-sre and eng-platform for review after initial draft. :sparkles:
